nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: File-collection and environment helpers for the advanced-search indexing pipeline, providing gitignore-aware parallel directory walking, GPU layer configuration lookup, and supported file-extension filtering.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Aggregates the advanced-search Tauri command surface, conditionally re-exporting the semantic-search implementation or the no-op stub API based on the `semantic-search` Cargo feature, and exposes a `check_advanced_search_enabled` command.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `#[cfg(feature = ...)]` to select between two mutually-exclusive module implementations (semantic_commands vs stubs) at compile time.

nodes.name: semantic_commands.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the full set of Tauri commands for semantic code search when the `semantic-search` feature is enabled: model directory/download management, repository indexing (full and incremental), semantic query search, and embedder lifecycle control, with cfg-gated no-op fallbacks for builds without the feature.
nodes.languageNotes: Many functions are declared twice under `#[cfg(feature = "semantic-search")]` and `#[cfg(not(...))]` with the same name; only one variant compiles per build.

nodes.name: stubs.rs
nodes.summary: No-op fallback implementations of the advanced-search Tauri commands used when the `semantic-search` Cargo feature is disabled, returning errors or empty results for every semantic search operation.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the request/response data structures (SearchFilters, IncrementalResult, EmbeddingModelStatus) shared by the advanced-search Tauri command handlers.

nodes.name: ipc.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the JSON-serializable Request/Response message protocol exchanged with the out-of-process embedding subprocess (init, embed, ping, shutdown).

nodes.name: metal.rs
nodes.summary: Implements GPU-accelerated text embedders for macOS/Apple Silicon: a channel-based GpuExecutor for thread-safe Metal access, a GgmlEmbedder wrapper, and a SubprocessEmbedder that manages a crash-recoverable child process communicating over the IPC protocol.
nodes.languageNotes: Platform-gated (macOS aarch64) module implementing process supervision with automatic restart-after-crash logic and a dedicated GPU worker thread communicating via mpsc channels.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the Embedder trait abstraction for text-to-vector embedding and provides a MockEmbedder implementation used for testing without a real model.

nodes.name: index.rs
nodes.summary: Implements SemanticIndex, the core vector index wrapper that manages chunk embedding, storage, similarity search, per-repository deletion, and idle-based lifecycle tracking for the semantic search feature.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the optional advanced-search stack; declares the commands, embedders, index, semantic, and types modules and conditionally re-exports the semantic-search public API behind the `semantic-search` Cargo feature.

nodes.name: semantic.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a single feature-availability check (`is_semantic_available`) used to gate semantic search functionality at runtime.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the core semantic-search data types (CodeChunkPayload, SemanticHit, SemanticConfig, CodeChunk) plus helper functions for deterministic point-ID generation and sliding-window code chunking.

nodes.name: read_file_content
nodes.summary: Reads a file's contents into a String, returning None on any I/O error.

nodes.name: collect_files
nodes.summary: Parallel, gitignore-aware directory walker (via `ignore::WalkBuilder`) that collects file paths matching extension and directory-exclusion filters for repository indexing.

nodes.name: get_gpu_layers
nodes.summary: Reads the `ORGII_GPU_LAYERS` environment variable to determine how many GPU layers to offload for the embedding model, defaulting to 0.

nodes.name: is_supported_extension
nodes.summary: Checks a file extension against the list of source-code extensions supported for semantic indexing.

nodes.name: check_advanced_search_enabled
nodes.summary: Tauri command reporting whether the crate was compiled with the `semantic-search` feature enabled.

nodes.name: get_model_dir
nodes.summary: Returns the configured embedding model directory, falling back to the platform default if no custom directory was set.

nodes.name: set_model_dir
nodes.summary: Tauri command that validates and persists a custom embedding-model directory path, creating it if necessary.

nodes.name: get_model_dir_path
nodes.summary: Tauri command returning the current embedding-model directory as a string, or empty string when semantic search is unavailable.

nodes.name: check_semantic_available
nodes.summary: Tauri command exposing whether semantic search is available on the current platform/build.

nodes.name: ensure_semantic_index
nodes.summary: Lazily initializes the global SemanticIndex on first use, selecting between the subprocess and in-process (Metal GPU) embedder implementations based on platform and environment configuration.

nodes.name: check_embedding_model_status
nodes.summary: Tauri command reporting whether the embedding model files are installed and their combined size on disk.

nodes.name: delete_embedding_model
nodes.summary: Tauri command that removes the downloaded embedding model files (gguf weights and tokenizer) from disk.

nodes.name: download_embedding_model
nodes.summary: Tauri command that downloads the embedding model's GGUF weights and tokenizer files over HTTP with resumable, chunked progress reporting emitted to the frontend via Tauri events.

nodes.name: get_model_info
nodes.summary: Tauri command that builds a human-readable diagnostic report describing installed embedding model files and their sizes.

nodes.name: search_semantic
nodes.summary: Tauri command performing a semantic similarity search against the indexed repositories and returning paginated results.

nodes.name: index_repository_semantic
nodes.summary: Tauri command that performs a full semantic re-index of a repository: walks matching files, chunks their content, embeds each batch with retry/backoff on transient embedder errors, and reports progress via Tauri events; the largest and most complex command in the crate.

nodes.name: remove_repository_semantic
nodes.summary: Tauri command that deletes all indexed chunks for a repository from the semantic index.

nodes.name: incremental_index_semantic
nodes.summary: Tauri command that re-indexes only the specified changed files of a repository, replacing their existing chunks with freshly embedded ones.

nodes.name: cancel_semantic_indexing
nodes.summary: Tauri command that signals cancellation of an in-progress semantic indexing operation for a repository.

nodes.name: stop_embedder
nodes.summary: Tauri command that shuts down the active subprocess embedder, releasing its resources.

nodes.name: debug_qdrant_collection_info
nodes.summary: Tauri diagnostic command that reports internal statistics about the semantic vector index/collection.

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Performs a similarity search over the vector index, optionally filtered by repository, and returns the top-matching code chunks.

nodes.name: batch_index_chunks
nodes.summary: Embeds and stores a batch of code chunks into the vector index and metadata database in a single pass.

nodes.name: delete_repo
nodes.summary: Removes all indexed vectors and metadata belonging to a given repository from the index.

nodes.name: is_semantic_available
nodes.summary: Determines at runtime whether semantic search can be used, based on feature compilation and platform/model requirements.

nodes.name: chunk_code
nodes.summary: Splits source code content into overlapping fixed-size chunks suitable for embedding, preserving line-number boundaries.

nodes.name: generate_point_id
nodes.summary: Deterministically derives a vector-database point ID from a repository path, relative file path, and starting line number.

nodes.name: SemanticHit
nodes.summary: Fallback definition of a semantic search hit result used when the `semantic-search` feature is disabled, mirroring the shape of the real SemanticHit type.

nodes.name: SearchFilters
nodes.summary: Request payload describing file-extension, directory-exclusion, and case/regex options for a code search operation.

nodes.name: IncrementalResult
nodes.summary: Result payload summarizing the outcome of an incremental indexing operation, including updated/failed file counts.

nodes.name: EmbeddingModelStatus
nodes.summary: Status payload describing whether the embedding model is installed and its on-disk size.

nodes.name: Request
nodes.summary: Enum of messages sent to the embedding subprocess: Init, Embed, Ping, Shutdown.

nodes.name: Response
nodes.summary: Enum of messages received from the embedding subprocess: Ready, Result, Pong, Error, Bye.

nodes.name: GpuExecutor
nodes.summary: Wraps a dedicated GPU worker thread behind an mpsc channel so Metal-backed embedding calls can be safely invoked from async/multi-threaded Tauri command handlers.

nodes.name: GgmlEmbedder
nodes.summary: In-process GGML/Metal embedder implementation used on Apple Silicon to compute text embeddings without spawning a subprocess.

nodes.name: SubprocessEmbedder
nodes.summary: Manages a long-lived child process running the embedding model, communicating via the IPC protocol, with automatic crash detection and restart.

nodes.name: Embedder
nodes.summary: Trait abstraction for text-to-vector embedding, implemented by both the mock and real (Metal/subprocess) embedder backends.

nodes.name: MockEmbedder
nodes.summary: Deterministic in-memory Embedder implementation used in tests to avoid loading a real model.

nodes.name: SemanticIndex
nodes.summary: Central vector-index type coordinating an embedder, vector store, and metadata database to index, search, and delete code chunks per repository.

nodes.name: CodeChunkPayload
nodes.summary: Serializable payload describing a single indexed code chunk (repo, path, language, content, line range, content hash) stored in the vector database.

nodes.name: SemanticHit
nodes.summary: Search result type describing a matched code chunk and its similarity score.

nodes.name: SemanticConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the semantic index: collection name, embedding model identifier, and chunking parameters.

nodes.name: CodeChunk
nodes.summary: In-memory representation of a chunked slice of source code with its line range and content hash.
